_note: Assembled 2026-10-19 from a live web search for 'Spain floods October 2026 towns affected deaths'. The URLs and titles in research.citations and research.results are the real results (titles as the search returned them, junk ones included); the notes text and cited text were written from what those results reported. The search also surfaced 2024 Valencia pages with 2026 page dates. The parsed block is a hand-made model answer with deliberate faults for the validation tests: an uncited figure URL, a figure given by number, a trailing-slash URL, a place in France, the country itself as a place, a repeated place, and a plain-http donation page.

disaster.title: Flood in Spain
disaster.summary: Flood in Spain reported by GDACS.

research.text:
Status: flash flooding in early October 2026; reports run to about 5 October and do not say whether waters are still high.
Places: Madrigueras (Albacete, Castilla-La Mancha): flooded, a 102-year-old woman died and firefighters rescued about 90 people. Tordera (Barcelona, Catalonia): one person killed when a wall collapsed. Montornès del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia): one person died. Pineda de Mar (Barcelona, Catalonia): one person missing.
Figures: 3 deaths (2 in Catalonia, 1 in Madrigueras); 1 missing; about 90 people rescued in Madrigueras. Reports of about 95 or 158 deaths in Valencia describe the October 2024 floods, not this event.
Donation pages: none found.

parsed.summary: Flash floods in early October 2026 killed three people in Spain. In Madrigueras, Castilla-La Mancha, a 102-year-old woman died and firefighters rescued about 90 people. In Catalonia, one person died in Tordera when a wall collapsed, another in Montornès del Vallès, and one person is missing in Pineda de Mar.
